ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M1-2
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 22-B in the area bound by:

a line 231.5 feet north of and parallel to East 95" Street; South Escanaba
Avenue, East 95" Street; and the east right-of-way line of South Marquette Road,
if extended north where no street exists,

to those of a B2-1, Community Shopping District,

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

A
Z

Greay I. Mitchell
man, 7th Ward

Common Addresses:

2700-2864 E. 95" Street
